ad.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
ad.description:
Role Overview

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at HOPE Technik, you will play a vital role in maintaining the quality and reliability of innovative products across robotics, automation, and special vehicle projects. This hands-on role involves testing, analyzing, and improving products to ensure they consistently meet rigorous standards and specifications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Testing and Validation

  • Test Planning: Formulate comprehensive test plans and thoroughly test products and components to ensure they meet predefined quality standards.

  • Protocol Development: Develop and implement testing protocols and procedures across various stages of product development.

  • Execution: Utilize a strategic mix of both manual and automated testing techniques.

2. Issue Identification and Resolution

  • Defect Detection: Proactively identify defects, bugs, or inconsistencies in products and engineering processes.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with the product development team to deeply understand requirements and ensure quality considerations are integrated from the start.

  • Problem Solving: Provide actionable insights, root-cause analyses, and recommendations to resolve quality issues effectively.

3. Continuous Improvement

  • Process Enhancement: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to boost overall product quality and production efficiency.

  • Data Analysis: Analyze QA data and feedback loops to identify patterns, trends, and systemic areas for improvement.

  • Best Practices: Recommend modifications to products or processes based on findings and current industry best practices.

4. Documentation and Reporting

  • Record Keeping: Maintain meticulous and accurate records of testing procedures, methodologies, and test results.

  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports on quality assurance activities, findings, and overall project progress for management.

  • Compliance: Ensure all documentation complies with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies.

5. Collaboration and Communication

  • Lifecycle Integration: Work closely with design, production, and software development teams to seamlessly integrate QA into all phases of the product development lifecycle.

  • Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with team members, management, and external stakeholders regarding quality metrics, objectives, and outcomes.

  • Team Participation: Actively participate in regular team meetings and provide clear, concise updates on QA progress.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Assurance, or a related technical field.

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Quality Assurance Engineer or in a similar role—ideally with direct experience in robotics, automation, or vehicle engineering.

  • QA Expertise: Strong core understanding of quality assurance methodologies, tools, and industry standards.

  • Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with statistical analysis and specialized quality testing tools; strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities.

  • Soft Skills: High attention to detail, exceptional problem-solving abilities, strong organizational skills, and excellent teamwork and communication capabilities.

  • Bonus: Knowledge of industry-specific regulations and standards is highly advantageous.

ad.title: Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) Lead
ad.description:
Role Summary

The Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) Lead is responsible for planning, developing, and managing all ILS activities across programs (especially Defence) to ensure systems, vehicles, equipment, and platforms achieve required operational availability, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle supportability.

This role ensures the delivered system can be effectively operated, maintained, repaired, and sustained throughout its service life in accordance with customer requirements.

The ILS Lead works closely with engineering, operations, field support, supply chain, quality, training, and customers to establish a complete support ecosystem from design phase through in-service support.

Key Responsibilities

1. ILS Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute the overall ILS strategy for defence programs

  • Prepare and manage the ILS Plan (ILSP)

  • Ensure compliance with customer ILS requirements, standards, and contractual obligations

  • Define lifecycle support concepts from development to end-of-life disposal

  • Establish maintenance philosophy and support concepts (Organisational, Intermediate, Depot level maintenance)

  • Participate in design reviews to ensure supportability is built into the product from the beginning

2. Reliability, Availability & Maintainability (RAM)

  • Perform RAM analysis for systems and subsystems

  • Calculate and manage:

    • MTBF (Mean Time Between Failure)

    • MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)

    • MTTF (Mean Time To Failure)

    • Availability (Ao / Ai)

    • Reliability growth targets

    • Failure rate analysis

  • Conduct Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)

  • Conduct Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) studies

  • Support root cause analysis for field failures and recurring faults

  • Recommend design improvements to improve reliability and maintainability

3. Maintenance Planning

  • Develop preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance strategies

  • Establish scheduled maintenance intervals and inspection plans

  • Define maintenance task analysis (MTA)

  • Determine manpower, tooling, facilities, and infrastructure requirements

  • Plan workshop layout, repair bays, storage areas, and maintenance space requirements

  • Define calibration requirements and support equipment needs

  • Develop maintenance resource planning for fleet sustainment

4. Spare Parts & Supply Support

  • Develop Initial Provisioning Lists (IPL)

  • Determine Recommended Spare Parts Lists (RSPL)

  • Plan Lay-In Spares (LIS)

  • Establish sparing philosophy and inventory optimisation

  • Define repairable vs consumable parts strategy

  • Forecast demand and lifecycle spare requirements

  • Coordinate with procurement and supply chain for support readiness

5. Technical Documentation

  • Lead development of:

    • Maintenance manuals

    • Operator manuals

    • Illustrated Parts Catalogues (IPC)

    • Troubleshooting guides

    • Repair procedures

    • Service bulletins

    • Configuration records

  • Ensure technical publications meet defence standards and audit requirements

  • Manage document revisions and change control

6. Training & Capability Development

  • Develop operator and maintainer training plans

  • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA)

  • Define competency requirements for maintenance crews

  • Establish training syllabus, lesson plans, and practical assessments

  • Support train-the-trainer programs

  • Build long-term maintenance capability for customer teams

7. After-Sales Support & Service Operations

  • Lead post-delivery support operations

  • Establish issue ticketing, incident reporting, and fault escalation processes

  • Manage defect reporting and corrective action systems

  • Coordinate warranty support and field service response

  • Support service-level agreement (SLA) performance management

  • Track fleet health, service KPIs, and support performance

8. Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as primary ILS interface with defence customers

  • Present ILS status, RAM performance, and sustainment plans

  • Support tender submissions, technical proposals, and audits

  • Participate in customer reviews, acceptance testing, and sustainment discussions

  • Manage subcontractors and OEM support partners where required

9. Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor an ILS team of approximately 5 personnel

  • Allocate tasks across RAM, spares, documentation, and field support activities

  • Develop team capability and ILS best practices

  • Drive continuous improvement across lifecycle support processes


Requirements

Education

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Logistics Engineering, or related field

Experience

  • 8–15 years of experience in defence programs, aerospace, military vehicles, special vehicles, or complex engineering systems

  • Strong experience in ILS, RAM, maintenance engineering, or sustainment programs

  • Familiarity with Singapore defence customer expectations and ILS practices preferred

Technical Knowledge

Strong knowledge of:

  • ILS methodology

  • MIL-STD / DEF-STAN / ASD standards

  • RAM engineering

  • FMECA / RCM / LORA / MTA

  • Obsolescence management

  • Configuration management

  • Lifecycle cost (LCC) analysis

  • Maintenance planning systems

  • Defence documentation standards

  • ERP / CMMS / maintenance ticketing systems

Preferred Skills

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills

  • Good commercial understanding of lifecycle support contracts

  • Ability to work across engineering and operations teams

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

  • Specialist Diploma in WSH or equivalent.
  • Must be a registered WSHO with the Ministry of Manpower MOM and a registered ECO with National Environment Agency NEA.
  • Minimum 5 years working experience relevant to the work to be carried out by a WSHO, with good knowledge of Health, Safety, and Environmental Law & Regulations of Singapore.
  • Experience in LTA roadworks, PUB, or building projects.
  • Self-driven and able to work within tight deadlines and shift work, if required.
  • Self-motivated team player with excellent organisational and communication skills.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint).
